mapper.sql: id, request_id, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, status, order_id, stock_bucket_version, stock_bucket_no, processing_at, redis_deducted, deducted_quantity, deducted_at, compensated, compensation_status, compensated_at, fail_reason, message_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_order_request ( request_id, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, status, order_id, stock_bucket_version, stock_bucket_no, processing_at, redis_deducted, deducted_quantity, deducted_at, compensated, compensation_status, compensated_at, fail_reason, message_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{showId}, #{sessionId}, #{ticketCategoryId}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{orderId}, COALESCE(#{stockBucketVersion}, 1), #{stockBucketNo}, #{processingAt}, #{redisDeducted}, #{deductedQuantity}, #{deductedAt}, #{compensated}, #{compensationStatus}, #{compensatedAt}, #{failReason}, #{messageId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM ticket_order_request WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM ticket_order_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_order_request SET status = 'PRE_DEDUCTED', redis_deducted = TRUE, deducted_quantity = #{deductedQuantity}, stock_bucket_no = #{stockBucketNo}, deducted_at = #{deductedAt}, compensation_status = 'NONE', fail_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'INIT'
UPDATE ticket_order_request SET status = 'QUEUED', message_id = #{messageId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PRE_DEDUCTED'
UPDATE ticket_order_request SET status = 'QUEUED', message_id = #{messageId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE ticket_order_request SET status = 'PROCESSING', processing_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status IN ('PRE_DEDUCTED', 'QUEUED')
UPDATE ticket_order_request SET status = 'SUCCESS', order_id = #{orderId}, fail_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE ticket_order_request SET status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('INIT', 'PRE_DEDUCTED', 'QUEUED', 'PROCESSING')
UPDATE ticket_order_request SET status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE ticket_order_request SET status = 'QUEUED', fail_reason = NULL, processing_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'PROCESSING') AND order_id IS NULL AND compensated = FALSE AND compensation_status IN ('NONE', 'COMPENSATE_FAILED')

UPDATE ticket_order_request SET compensation_status = 'COMPENSATING', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED' AND redis_deducted = TRUE AND compensated = FALSE AND compensation_status IN ('NONE', 'COMPENSATE_FAILED')

UPDATE ticket_order_request SET compensation_status = 'COMPENSATE_FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED' AND compensation_status = 'COMPENSATING'

UPDATE ticket_order_request SET status = 'COMPENSATED', compensated = TRUE, compensation_status = 'COMPENSATED', compensated_at = #{compensatedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED' AND compensated = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deducted_quantity), 0) FROM ticket_order_request WHERE ticket_category_id = #{ticketCategoryId} AND status IN ('PRE_DEDUCTED', 'QUEUED', 'PROCESSING') AND redis_deducted = TRUE AND compensated = FALSE AND compensation_status IN ('NONE', 'COMPENSATE_FAILED') AND deducted_quantity > 0

SELECT
FROM ticket_order_request WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND redis_deducted = TRUE AND compensated = FALSE AND compensation_status IN ('NONE', 'COMPENSATE_FAILED') AND deducted_quantity > 0 ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
